fsm_states_flexbus_negotiation.name: PCIe_LinkTraining
fsm_states_flexbus_negotiation.description: Standard PCIe LTSSM training over the Flex Bus; Alternate Protocol (CXL) is advertised in TS1/TS2 modified ordered sets.

fsm_states_flexbus_negotiation.name: CXL_AltProtocol_Negotiate
fsm_states_flexbus_negotiation.description: Both ends advertise CXL capability + supported CXL version (1.1 / 2.0 / 3.0) via the PCIe Alternate Protocol mechanism.

fsm_states_flexbus_negotiation.name: CXL_Mode
fsm_states_flexbus_negotiation.description: Link operates as CXL; CXL.io + CXL.cache + CXL.mem stacks enabled; ARB/MUX active.

fsm_states_flexbus_negotiation.name: PCIe_Mode
fsm_states_flexbus_negotiation.description: Partner not CXL-capable (or CXL not negotiated); link operates as plain PCIe.

fsm_states_arbmux.name: ARBMUX_IDLE
fsm_states_arbmux.description: No pending Flit traffic; PM-state requests handled (ARB/MUX manages link PM virtual LSM per sub-protocol).

fsm_states_arbmux.name: ARBMUX_CXLIO
fsm_states_arbmux.description: Arbitrates a Flit window to the CXL.io link/transaction stack.

fsm_states_arbmux.name: ARBMUX_CXLCACHEMEM
fsm_states_arbmux.description: Arbitrates a Flit window to the common CXL.cache + CXL.mem link/transaction stack.

fsm_states_coherency.name: I (Invalid)
fsm_states_coherency.description: Cache line not present (MESI-style device cache state for CXL.cache).

fsm_states_coherency.name: S (Shared)
fsm_states_coherency.description: Line cached read-only; may be shared with host / other devices.

fsm_states_coherency.name: M (Modified)
fsm_states_coherency.description: Line cached modified (dirty); device owns the only valid copy.

fsm_states_coherency.name: BI (Back-Invalidate)
fsm_states_coherency.description: CXL 3.0: device issues Back-Invalidation to invalidate host-cached copies after modifying local memory.

fsm_hints.trigger: Flex Bus training + Alternate-Protocol negotiation selects CXL vs PCIe; once CXL mode is entered the ARB/MUX begins per-Flit arbitration.
fsm_hints.rule: CXL.cache device caches host lines via D2H Req; host snoops via H2D Req; CXL.mem host accesses device memory via M2S Req / RwD with S2M NDR / DRS responses.
fsm_hints.abort: Uncorrectable / fatal errors set the viral state so dependent agents quiesce; Flit CRC/FEC failures trigger link-layer replay.

anti_deadlock_rule: Coherence is asymmetric — only the host memory controller is the cache agent — which bounds the protocol state and avoids the deadlock complexity of symmetric CPU-CPU coherence. Channel credits are tracked per message class so a slow class cannot block others.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: PERST# deassertion → PCIe Flex Bus trains → Alternate-Protocol negotiation selects CXL → CXL.io enumerates the device via PCIe config + CXL DVSEC → host programs HDM Decoders + enables CXL.cache/CXL.mem → ARB/MUX activates and coherent traffic begins.

configurations.name: Type 1 device
configurations.description: CXL.io + CXL.cache; no device memory; coherent accelerator.

configurations.name: Type 2 device
configurations.description: CXL.io + CXL.cache + CXL.mem; accelerator with local HBM/GDDR.

configurations.name: Type 3 device
configurations.description: CXL.io + CXL.mem; memory expander / persistent memory.
